adversarialCases.scenario: A reviewer needs to start by viewing video or recovered material rather than scanning decorative workflow/status panels.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: The viewer appears first, source/stat/activity panels are not first-screen blockers, and candidate rows remain visible.

adversarialCases.scenario: The first screen must not imply evidence is validated or release-ready.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: local-first, verification required, and candidate-unvalidated remain visible while exaggerated launch wording is absent.

adversarialCases.scenario: Small tablet/mobile widths can hide controls, clip text, or create horizontal overflow.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: 375, 768, and 1280 viewports have no horizontal overflow and no page errors.

adversarialCases.scenario: A GUI-only follow-up should not destabilize Rust library behavior.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: cargo test --lib passes and the Rust engine remains unchanged for this viewer-first follow-up.

criteriaCoverage.originalIntent: Make gui/evidence-viewer read like a local forensic video evidence review tool with evidence sources, video candidates, validation, export, and report flow visible without exaggerated claims.
criteriaCoverage.desiredOutcome: After user clarification, the first screen prioritizes viewing video or recovered material and keeps only review-needed source/candidate/validation/export/report states.
